title: The tangent plane of an orthogonal graph map is n-dimensional
statement: Let n, k ∈ ℕ, and let ι : ℝⁿ → ℝ^{n+k} and ι' : ℝ^k → ℝ^{n+k} be linear isometries with ⟨ιv, ι'w⟩ = 0 for all v ∈ ℝⁿ, w ∈ ℝ^k. Let u : ℝⁿ → ℝ^k be differentiable at v₀ ∈ ℝⁿ, let z ∈ ℝ^{n+k}, and put Φ(v) := z + ιv + ι'u(v). Then the linear subspace range DΦ(v₀) ⊆ ℝ^{n+k} has dimension n. Here DΦ(v₀) = fderiv ℝ Φ v₀, viewed as a linear map.
lean_statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (u : Euclid n → Euclid k) (z : Euclid (n + k)) (v₀ : Euclid n), (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → DifferentiableAt ℝ u v₀ → Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ (fun v => z + ι v + ι' (u v)) v₀ : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k))) = n
